turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that.
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
I'm not here to write poetry for you, Hale. The zero comes off, I get an apology, and Owen gets an answer. Who decided?
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏
No. You've had two chances to answer me, Hale, and you've used both on games. Who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
I'm not shouting for you, Hale. Three times now you've dodged one question, and I'm writing that down. Answer it, or I'm walking upstairs to the principal.
That's four, Hale, and the principal's office is my next stop. Who decided on the zero?
Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.

November 3, and today is November 10, and in that week nobody called me. Did you enter it yourself, and did you speak to Owen before you did? Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark goes in.
